tree.heading: Representation.—
tree.text: A person may represent, by marking or otherwise, that—

children.text: a package, component of a package, or packaging for transporting hazardous material is safe, certified, or complies with this chapter only if the package, component of a package, or packaging meets the requirements of each applicable regulation prescribed under this chapter; or
hazardous material is present in a package, container, motor vehicle, rail freight car, aircraft, or vessel only if the material is present.

tree.heading: Tampering.—
tree.text: No person may alter, remove, destroy, or otherwise tamper unlawfully with—

children.text: a marking, label, placard, or description on a document required under this chapter or a regulation prescribed under this chapter; or
a package, component of a package, or packaging, container, motor vehicle, rail freight car, aircraft, or vessel used to transport hazardous material.

notes.heading: Pub. L. 103–429
notes.text: This amends 49:5104(a)(1) to clarify the restatement of 49 App.:1804(e)(1) by section 1 of the Act of July 5, 1994 (Public Law 103–272, 108 Stat. 761).

notes.text: 2005—Subsec. (a)(1). Pub. notes.heading: Effective Date of 1994 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 103–429 effective July 5, 1994, see section 9 of Pub. L. 103–429, set out as a note under section 321 of this title.
